notes.title: Thanks for an Amazing Steam Next Fest & It's Time to Get Back to Development!
notes.content:
[h3][i]Hello everyone,[/i][/h3][p][i]We've just wrapped up an amazing Steam Next Fest! A heartfelt thank you to everyone who played our demos, shared valuable feedback, and most importantly, believed in our projects by wishlisting our games during this busy and exciting week![/i][/p][p][i]To all the new players who discovered us and joined us during the festival, we want to give a huge "Welcome!" on behalf of our team. As an independent studio, your interest and support are our greatest source of fuel and motivation.[/i]  
[/p][h3][b]Now, It's Time to Get Back to Development![/b][/h3][p]We've gathered all the valuable feedback and notes we received from you during the festival. In the coming months, we'll be focusing all our energy on turning our games into the content-rich and polished final versions we envision. Your patience and support during this process are invaluable to us. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Follow Our Journey on Our Shared Channels[/b][/h3][p]We are a small team working on two different projects at the same time. That's why we share all news, behind-the-scenes content, and important announcements about our development journey on our shared social media channels. By following us, you can stay up-to-date on the progress of both our games.  
[/p][h3][i]Thank you again for being with us on this exciting journey. We'll be back with more news and updates soon!  [/i][/h3][p][i]
Best,[/i]    

[i]Bavsimus[/i]
[b][i]Zero Task[/i][/b][/p]
